text.tspan: SimGNN graph attention readout | Operators & tensor flow
module only / reviewed fixed source / independent operands / read bottom to top
Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.
Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.
Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
